title: GenerationJob request payload — academy-brain.generate-session
description: Shape of GenerationJob.Payload for operation 'academy-brain.generate-session' (STEP 5). contractVersion is this schema's own version — it is NOT an academy-brain release number (DEC-004 retired those) and it is NOT the Studio build that executes the job (see result.schema.json's studioBuild). Every value here is an execution-boundary value the CourseDeveloper.Worker subprocess adapter passes to generate_session.py's --root; none of it is end-user-configured (DEC-005 — the API derives courseVaultRoot and pythonExecutable from the project's Organization/CourseProject config).

contractVersion.description: This request/result schema's own version. Queued jobs can survive a deployment, so a worker must be able to tell which contract shape it is reading.

sessionId.description: academy-brain session id, e.g. 'L1-s1'. Validated again on the Python side by CoursePaths.validate_session_id against the course.yaml at courseVaultRoot.

courseVaultRoot.description: Absolute path passed as generate_session.py --root. Resolved by the API from the owning Organization/CourseProject, not entered by the end user.

live.description: false = dry run (plan printed, nothing uploaded, no NotebookLM quota spent). true = a real generation run; requires pythonExecutable.

pythonExecutable.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter with the notebooklm package and stored NotebookLM session for this job's notebooklm_account_key (see generation_job.notebooklm_account_key, STEP 4). Required when live is true; ignored for dry runs. This IS the NotebookLM credential reference this step externalizes — academy-brain's own source never hardcodes it.
